description: LR Calendar is a professional-grade long range calendar visual for Microsoft Power BI, purpose-built for program managers, project leads, and operations teams who need to see the big picture across time. Unlike standard Gantt visuals that force every event onto its own row, LR Calendar uses an intelligent row-packing algorithm that places non-overlapping events side by side — dramatically reducing vertical space and keeping your timeline compact and readable at any scale. Zoom Levels Navigate your timeline at four levels of detail — Day, Week, Month, and Year — with a simple scroll wheel. The header automatically adjusts to show the right level of date context, with full support for both Fiscal Year and Calendar Year labeling. Organization & Project Hierarchy Group events by Organization and Project with an expandable/collapsible hierarchy. Show both levels together, or toggle either off for a flatter view. Each organization displays a summary span bar showing its full-time footprint at a glance. Multiple Milestone Types Map an integer field (1, 2, or 3) to display milestones as Stars, Triangles, or Diamonds — each with its own color. Milestones from different workstreams are visually distinct at every zoom level. Rich Formatting Customize bar colors by category, bar height, font size, label width, header height, event spacing, label character limit, org/project text color,…
